## Execute code from anywhere.

Send code, get output. No infrastructure, no Docker, no cold starts. A single API call runs your code in a secure sandbox and returns stdout, stderr, and exit code in milliseconds.

curl -X POST https://api.cdbx.ai/v1/runner/execute \ -H "Authorization: Bearer cdbx_your_key" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "language": "python", "files": { "main.py": "print('Hello!')" }, "entrypoint": "main.py" }' | jq # { # "stdout": "Hello!\n", # "exitCode": 0, # "durationMs": 94 # }
